mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, sales_platform, shop_id, shop_name, source_type, source_id, source_code, outstock_id, outstock_code, channel_id, order_time, delivery_time, transport_no
mapper.select: SELECT lbd.id AS detailId, lb.id, lb.sales_platform AS salesPlatform, lb.shop_id AS shopId, lb.shop_name AS shopName, lb.source_type AS sourceType, lb.order_type AS orderType, lb.source_id AS sourceId, lb.source_code AS sourceCode, lb.outstock_id AS outstockId, lb.outstock_code AS outstockCode, lb.channel_id AS channelId, lb.order_time AS orderTime, lb.delivery_time AS deliveryTime, lb.transport_no AS transportNo, lb.to_country AS toCountry, lbd.track_no AS trackNo FROM logistics_bill_detail lbd LEFT JOIN logistics_bill lb ON lbd.main_id=lb.id ANd lb.is_deleted=false WHERE lbd.is_deleted=false AND lbd.track_no=#{trackNo} LIMIT 1
